data.name: Aahoo
data.gender_notes: Aahoo is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Persian āhū (آهو) 'gazelle, deer'. In Persian and Urdu poetry the gazelle is a classic image of beauty and grace, which is why the word is used as a female given name. Aahoo therefore means “Gazelle; deer”. Persian noun āhū 'gazelle, deer'; used as a female given name in Persian and Urdu.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aahoo expresses “Jasmine”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
